issues.title: Guatemalan lawmaker, three police officers killed in armed attack
issues.title_en: Guatemalan lawmaker, three police officers killed in armed attack
issues.summary: GUATEMALA CITY, Nov 7 - A Guatemalan lawmaker and three police officers were killed in an armed attack in the eastern department of Zacapa, President Bernardo Arévalo said, condemning the violence and ordering security forces to help identify those responsible. Read more at straitstimes.com.
